case_number: 2024 INSC 628; CIVIL APPEAL NOs. 9781-9782 of 2024 @ SLP (C) Nos. 8128 -8129 of 2021

parties.respondent: The State Of West Bengal & Anr.

summary: Dispute over arbitral award in road construction contract; claims for loss of business (set aside as not claimed), uneconomic plant utilization (restored after High Court reversal), idle labor charges (set aside as contract prohibits), interest on delayed payments (set aside due to timely payments), escalation (affirmed), interest modification (allowed only pendent lite/post award); High Court improperly interfered with arbitrator's findings on permissible claims under Hudson's formula; Contract clauses barred claims for idle labor and machinery costs; Arbitrator's award upheld on maintainable claims; High Court judgment partially reversed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; High Court judgment set aside for claims 3 and 4; claim 2 restored; claim 6 modified to exclude pre-reference interest; Arbitrator's award upheld on maintainable claims.
